author: time news
title: TV’s Back: A Guide to the Most Anticipated Shows of 2025
text:
• Television is making a comeback in 2025 after a long drought caused by Hollywood strikes.
• Several new seasons and returning shows are set to premiere in spring and summer 2025.
• Severance (Apple TV+) Season 2 premiered on January 17th and runs through March 21st, featuring new cast members.
• Cobra Kai (Netflix) Season 3 will drop on February 13th, culminating the series' storyline.
• Love Is Blind (Netflix) returns for its eighth season on February 14th, focusing on singles dating without seeing each other.
• The White Lotus (HBO) Season 3 premieres on February 16th, set in Thailand with a new cast.
• Streaming services like Apple TV+, Netflix, and HBO Max are dominating the television landscape.
• The shift to streaming has led to a decline in conventional network television and a rise in original programming.
• The Last of Us (HBO) will return for a second season in April, continuing the story of Ellie and Joel.
• Reacher (Prime Video) Season 3 premieres on February 20th, featuring Jack Reacher in a new adventure.
• Squid Game (Netflix) Season 3 is set to premiere on June 27th, concluding the series' storyline.
• The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives (Hulu) will return for a second season this spring, focusing on Utah-based TikTok influencers.
• Other notable shows include The Staircase and The Jinx (HBO Max) for true crime, and The Mandalorian (Disney+) and Stranger Things (Netflix) for sci-fi and fantasy.
